research_question: When a central bank changes its primary policy priority after a macro turning point, and relative front-end rates confirm that shift, does the currency subsequently move in the same relative policy direction versus USD?

result_blind_base.reason: Reuse only already-certified PIT macro/rates plumbing before the corrected alignment economic result was observed.

central_bank_focus.eligible_communication: official monetary-policy decision communication only; statement and official press-conference/opening material released with the decision may be combined into one event record
central_bank_focus.priority_impulse: current ordered policy score minus immediately previous eligible decision-event score for the same central bank
central_bank_focus.relative_priority_impulse: local priority impulse minus FED priority impulse known at the local event timestamp; if FED has no new event since its prior decision, FED impulse is 0

focus_label_governance.focus_evidence: short contemporaneous evidence excerpt or structured evidence note supporting the primary focus; future market outcomes forbidden
focus_label_governance.ambiguous_focus_action: BALANCED_OR_WITHHOLD_PER_CODEBOOK; never infer from subsequent market reaction

macro_turning_confirmation.inputs: same strict PIT inflation and unemployment streams already normalized by the G4USD macro readiness chain
macro_turning_confirmation.inflation_pressure: change(local PIT-known inflation) minus change(US PIT-known inflation)
macro_turning_confirmation.labour_pressure: negative of [change(local PIT-known unemployment) minus change(US PIT-known unemployment)]
macro_turning_confirmation.confirmation_rule: inflation_pressure and labour_pressure must each be either zero or have the same sign as relative_priority_impulse, and at least one must have the same non-zero sign

rates_confirmation.source: same certified temporal-PIT local and US 2Y yield rowsets used by prior G4USD research
rates_confirmation.confirmation_window: five subsequent eligible rate observations after the CB event; no same-event future rate value may enter before it is PIT-eligible
rates_confirmation.relative_2y_repricing: relative_2y at fifth subsequent eligible rate observation minus relative_2y at last eligible observation at or before event publication
rates_confirmation.signal_becomes_tradeable: only after the fifth subsequent eligible rate observation confirms the shift

fx_outcome.orientation: positive return means local currency strengthens versus USD
fx_outcome.entry: first official FX fixing on or after rates-confirmation timestamp
fx_outcome.signed_return: sign(relative_priority_impulse) multiplied by local-vs-USD log FX return

predeclared_models.PRIMARY_FULL_CHAIN: CB relative priority shift + macro turning confirmation + 5-observation relative-2Y confirmation
predeclared_models.DIAGNOSTIC_CB_MACRO: CB relative priority shift + macro turning confirmation

historical_test_design.split: chronological 60/40 within each currency on eligible PRIMARY_FULL_CHAIN events
historical_test_design.event_overlap: all eligible decision events retained; no post-result event pruning

readiness_blocker.reason: No structured historical official-central-bank priority dataset exists in the repository yet. The economic test must remain blocked until that dataset is built and certified without using FX/rates outcomes.
